content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will be holding a Regular Meeting on Monday, September 16, 2024, at 6 p.m.; the meeting agenda can be found here. Please note: The Regular Meeting can be viewed via livestream on the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3.

Public comment for this meeting can be provided via online submission. To electronically submit written public comments for this meeting, please complete the form here. Electronic submission of public comment will be accepted until noon on Monday, September 16, 2024. 

The purpose of public comment is for members of our Board of Directors to hear public concerns, comments, and opinions.  Board members will not respond to submitted public comments.
